title: Getting started with CoDa Stereo
text: Data Upload. Load CSV Excel file select columns form composition (parts). Non-numeric columns treatment site become candidate grouping factors. pre-flight check flags parts incompatible scale. Five examples built : simulated liver dataset four case studies companion paper. rows fields view nested within specimens (example three fields per animal), tick Aggregate rows specimen: fields animal independent replicates. Point counts summed; areas proportions averaged. Data Inspection. three-state heatmap distinguishes observed values, zeros missing values. Zero Handling. Log-ratios undefined zeros, zeros replaced analysis. Use CZM count zeros (point counting), multRepl lrEM rounded zeros (values detection). Missing values can dropped replaced column geometric mean. Compositional Analysis. Ternary diagrams (optional amalgamation three parts, 95% confidence predictive regions per group), clr-biplot, variation matrix, compositional centre total variance per group. Open read biplot guidance interpreting rays links. Every figure can exported PDF, PNG, SVG TIFF. Balances (SBP). automatic sequential binary partition can edited cell cell. CoDa dendrogram shows mean variance balance distribution per group; balance can tested groups. Statistical Modeling. Permutational MANOVA ilr coordinates (RRPP::lm.rrpp()) factors, covariates block term, pairwise comparisons means dispersions, residual diagnostics. Reproducibility. Download R script reproduces analysis, self-contained HTML report, save session resume later. interface available English, Portuguese Spanish (EN / PT / ES header); link can open app directly one language, e.g. ?lang=es.

title: Getting started with CoDa Stereo
text: default composition analysed, discards total. parts measured absolute scale (example, compartment volumes obtained volume fraction times Cavalieri organ volume, cells per microlitre), total can carry biological information. Choose Total (size) Statistical Modeling tab analyse log-total jointly ilr coordinates, covariate ask whether composition changes size. sum parts (Ts) default; product total (Tp) equivalent analysing log part (Pawlowsky-Glahn, Egozcue Lovell 2015, doi:10.1177/1471082X14535526). point-counting stereology total usually fixed design: number grid points, fields cells counted every specimen. total carries biological information included. app warns totals almost constant.

CoDaStereo 3.1.0
text: four case-study datasets companion paper (spleen kidney point counts per field, leukocyte differentials, erythrocyte nuclear abnormalities) available examples. Nested designs: fields view can aggregated one composition per specimen (counts summed, areas averaged). block term model restricts permutations within blocks.

title: CoDaStereo 3.1.0
text: Every figure can exported PDF, PNG, SVG TIFF chosen size (cm), resolution font size. clr-biplot drawn ggplot2 (factoextra longer dependency). adds axis choice, shape second factor, sample labels, scree plot table ray lengths. can include log-total extra variable (T-space biplot; Pawlowsky-Glahn, Egozcue & Lovell 2015). New heatmap variation matrix. Ternary plots can show 95% confidence predictive regions (ilr normal model) group geometric centres, computed zero-replaced composition. Balances tab: boxplots balance per group permutational test balance (F, Z, P). Interactive mode: hovering shows sample ternary plot biplot (ggiraph).

title: CoDaStereo 3.1.0
text: Numeric covariates (ANCOVA), block term, sums squares type , II III, 199, 999 9999 permutations fixed seed. log-total can enter covariate (“composition change size?”) well joint response. Pairwise tests also compare group dispersions (compositional disparity).

title: CoDaStereo 3.0.0
text: New Balances (SBP) tab. sequential binary partition built automatically Ward clustering parts clr distances. Users can edit cell (+1 / -1 / 0) reset automatic SBP. Edits validated fly (D - 1 balances, two-sided balances, one root split, nested partitions). tab shows balance definitions CoDa dendrogram (compositions::CoDaDendrogram()) per-group boxplots balance. dendrogram downloads PDF SBP CSV. Composition + total permutational MANOVA. log-total can added extra response coordinate next ilr coordinates, following Pawlowsky-Glahn, Egozcue & Lovell (2015, Statistical Modelling 15:175-190, doi:10.1177/1471082X14535526). Two totals available: sum parts (space Ts, default) product parts power 1/sqrt(D) (space Tp, isometric analysing log part). separate univariate model boxplot log-total separate size effects compositional effects. app warns totals almost constant (CV < 5%), happens number grid points cells counted fixed sampling design. Selectable colour palettes (Okabe-Ito, ColorBrewer Dark2, viridis) ternary plot, clr-biplot compositional descriptives. collapsible “read biplot” note explains rays, links, link angles limits planar approximation. New hex sticker.

title: CoDaStereo 3.0.0
text: clr-biplot now runs PCA centred, unscaled clr coordinates. Earlier versions called FactoMineR::PCA() default scale.unit = TRUE, standardised clr variables. equalised ray lengths, links longer approximated log-ratio standard deviations. Biplots produced 2.x differ.
